item.title: Rectal cancer rates are rising in U.S., driving an increase in illness in younger adults
item.description: A rise in rectal cancer rates is driving an increase in colorectal cancer diagnoses in people younger than 65, according to a report published Monday from the American Cancer Society.

item.title: Police release names of victims in Austin bar shooting
item.description: Law enforcement released the names of the two victims killed in a shooting at a bar in Austin, Texas, and said that one person who was hospitalized may be taken off life support. NBC News’ Priscilla Thompson reports on what is known so far about the gunman and the motive.

item.title: Supreme Court blocks Calif. limits on schools sharing student's transgender status with parents
item.description: The Supreme Court on Monday barred California from enforcing state rules that restrict when schools can notify parents about students who come out as transgender.

item.title: Hours of Clinton depositions about Epstein released
item.description: The House Oversight Committee released nine hours of testimony from Bill and Hillary Clinton about Jeffrey Epstein. Both denied any knowledge of Epstein’s criminal activity. NBC News’ Ryan Nobles reports.

item.title: They flew to Dubai for a romantic anniversary getaway. Then the bombing started.
item.description: An American couple who flew to Dubai have been stranded after Iran retaliated to attacks by the U.S. and Israel by striking its neighbors like the UAE.

item.title: State Department urges Americans across Mideast to depart as strikes continue
item.description: The weekend strikes against Iran have caused massive disruptions to U.S. embassies and consulates throughout the Middle East.

item.title: Dispatch from Tehran: Nowhere feels safe from attack
item.description: TEHRAN, Iran — Nowhere in Tehran feels safe anymore.

item.title: How Trump decided to strike Iran
item.description: A last chance to avert war with Iran played out Thursday in Geneva, where Trump's U.S. negotiators told Iran they must not take steps to build a nuclear bomb.

item.title: Iran-U.S. war chokes key shipping lane and threatens global cargo industry
item.description: The war in Iran is choking off a key shipping route in the global supply chain, potentially leading to massive delays in the flow of goods to American consumers

item.title: Trump says strikes on Iran could last four to five weeks
item.description: The Pentagon announced more troops and fighter jets are deploying to join the operation and confirmed at least six American service members have been killed, as Iran escalated its attacks on Israel and multiple Arab countries. NBC News’ Richard Engel reports.
